title: go-format telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the go-format hook. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "go-format". Evolves additive-only.

tool.description: Claude Code tool that triggered the hook (Write or Edit).

file.description: Path of the formatted Go file, relative to the consuming repo root.

findings.description: goimports syntax-error diagnostic lines when the file could not be parsed, one line per diagnostic. Empty array = clean or successfully autofixed (a successful format/import fix carries no findings).
